design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DESIGN DOSSIER — employer_charge_protests task 1 (category charge).

[0] Draw and claim. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}. One prerequisite problem; charge_ext_response_relief_credit (relief determination on a separation response, agent write, root) takes 5 factors and charge_ext_response_disputed_amount (the employer's separation response, user write) takes 4. Occupied by task 0: charge_ext_protest_amount / file_charge_protest_73ec7ae2 and charge_ext_protest_relief_credit / grant_charge_protest_0f56e95e (protest events). Claimed here, disjoint: charge_separation_response_filed (submit_separation_response_153a3a70) and charge_relief_determined (determine_charge_relief_e2b9af19). Nothing is reserved for later; the two tasks together cover all four extended policies and four tools.

[1] Why this is a good test. The owner of Wexcombe Hardware & Lumber (contributory, new-employer rate) only says that a former assistant yard manager quit, that the store has already been charged, and that it should not be charged. Nothing names a separation response. The agent must read in the relief-determination rule that "The relief credit of a determination on a separation response is not fixed until the position carries the employer's separation response, with the separation reason it reports and the date it was received recorded on it", see that the position is still noticed with no response, find that the write recording a response is the employer's own separation response, compute the disputed charge amount it states (five factors), hand it over, then compute the relief credit (four factors) on the post-response world and book it on the single charge still standing. The claim was backdated, so charges were posted on the day the notice was mailed — the reason a response here has charges to dispute at all.

[2] Problem-tree card. Root charge_ext_response_relief_credit; edge to charge_ext_response_disputed_amount: kind value_input, gate reported_reason (F('separation_reason_reported')), form state, policy_source (negated direction, in the root's own rule) "The relief credit of a determination on a separation response is not fixed until the position carries the employer's separation response, with the separation reason it reports and the date it was received recorded on it." Four-point test: "not ... until" ordering connective joining the root's result to its wait; the waited-on side is a record-visible state of the position; no tool, id or code token; hard requirement scoped to one response on this position. It is the exact contrapositive of "only after the position carries ...". Exactly one write of this difficulty records a separation response (submit_separation_response_153a3a70: status responded, response_date, separation_reason_reported, timeliness, separation_response submission). Derivation: sentence + records (status noticed, separation reason not_reported, response date empty, no charge_requests rows) + the disputed-amount rule ("A separation response that answers a notice of claim ... states a disputed charge amount") -> the employer's separation response, owner user. Seed evidence false at frozen_time: initial_state.charge_positions.<P1>.status = noticed, .separation_reason_reported = not_reported, .response_date = '', .response_timeliness = pending. Order: response (step 12) then determination (step 14). Deletion sensitivity: without the response the reported reason is not_reported, the relief ground share takes its zero tier while the relief answer share stays at the whole (no late answer on record), so the relief credit is RND(MX(0, 691.20 x 0.00 - 345.60) x 1.00) = 0.00 instead of 345.60. The charter carries both directions of prerequisite sentence (task 0's protest-decision sentence is affirmative "only after"). user_scenario names no response: the only reference is the passive "put its side on record" branch after the agent explains. Tools validate nothing (plain create/update).

[3] Base-invariant card. Write 1 (charge_separation_response_filed): governing charge_evt_notice_and_response, gate response_window (time): "A response is timely only when it is received no later than the response window after the notice of claim mailing date."; anchor charge_positions.notice_mailed_date 2026-11-03, duration variants.response_window_days 10, calendar days from the day after, not_after, inclusive -> last day 2026-11-13; frozen_time 2026-11-13 is day 10, the last day: satisfied (boundary inclusive), so response_timeliness is timely. Boundary: received 2026-11-14 would be late (and, without good cause, take the late-answer tier). Correlation: the gate's charge_position_id equals the call's. Write 2 (charge_relief_determined): governing charge_evt_relief_grounds (no structured gate); the Separating Employer — Most Recent class allows relief for a voluntary quit without good cause attributable to the employer (relief_voluntary_quit_without_good_cause true). The status path noticed -> responded -> relieved follows the base lifecycle.

[4] Business-object card. Target: position P1 of the store on claim CL1 (Dashiell Okafor-Brandt, Regular, filed 2026-11-02, effective date moved back to 2026-10-18 by an approved backdate request for agency error). Charges: 2026-11-04 (week ending 2026-10-31) 345.60 and 2026-11-09 (week ending 2026-11-07) 345.60 at share 0.8000 (17,280.00 / 21,600.00). Settled: the 2026-11-04 payment was returned by the bank and cancelled 2026-11-06 (not reissued), so its charge carries a payment_cancelled credit of 345.60. Standing: the 2026-11-09 charge, 345.60 — the one the relief credit names (source_charge_id post2).

[5] Factor card — charge_ext_response_disputed_amount (5 factors, expected 345.60, all-baseline 0.00). (a) response_counted_charges (method, multi-source): no statement mailed & charges posted -> every charge posted (691.20) / statement mailed listing charges -> latest statement's charges / otherwise -> none (baseline 0.00; the ordinary response precedes any charge). (b) response_financing_basis (method, multi-source, cross-difficulty taxacct): contributory tax account holding a reserve credited with contributions -> the counted charges, which reach that reserve (691.20) / reimbursing account billed for the latest statement's quarter -> the amount billed / otherwise nothing (baseline 0.00); evidence the Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate class and six taxacct_reserve_credited rows. (c) response_charges_left_out (method): a credit other than cancelled-payment -> every credit / only cancelled-payment credits -> those (345.60) / none; baseline gives 691.20. (d) response_class_share (parameter): regular or combined-wage position whose class allows relief for a quit, a misconduct discharge and a refused offer -> 1.00 / class allows only continuing part-time relief -> the latest charge over the counted charges / otherwise 0.00 — the Extended Benefits state-share class, whose relief follows the regular claim (reachable); Separating Employer -> 1.00; baseline gives 0.00. (e) answer_window_share (parameter): received within the window -> 1.00 / after the due date with no charge posted after it -> 0.90 / otherwise (after the due date with a charge posted after it) -> 0.75 (baseline); received 2026-11-13, the inclusive last day counted from the day after the 2026-11-03 mailing -> 1.00; baseline gives 259.20. Near-miss: the last-day boundary — counting the mailing day as day one would end the window 2026-11-12 and make today's answer late (0.90). RND(MX(0, 691.20 - 345.60) x 1.00 x 1.00) = 345.60.


[6] Factor card — charge_ext_response_relief_credit (4 factors, expected 345.60, all-baseline 0.00). (a) relief_window (method): no statement & charges posted -> every charge (691.20) / statement listing charges -> its charges / none (baseline 0.00). (b) credits_netted (method): only cancelled-payment credits -> those (345.60) / any other credit -> every credit / none (baseline 691.20). (c) relief_ground_share (parameter, multi-source): response reporting quit / misconduct / refused offer that the class allows -> 1.00 / response reporting continuing part-time that the class allows -> the most recent charge over the relief window / otherwise 0.00 (e.g. lack of work); voluntary_quit with relief_voluntary_quit_without_good_cause true -> 1.00 (baseline 0.00). (d) relief_answer_share (parameter, multi-source): on time or late with good cause -> 1.00 / late without good cause and no charge posted after the due date -> 0.90 / otherwise (late without good cause after a charge posted past the due date) -> 0.75 (baseline); response 2026-11-13 on the 2026-11-13 due date -> 1.00; baseline gives 259.20; near-miss the same inclusive last day. RND(MX(0, 691.20 x 1.00 - 345.60) x 1.00) = 345.60, the whole remaining 2026-11-09 charge — what a real voluntary-quit relief gives. The disputed amount and the relief credit coincide here because the class allows the reported ground and the answer is on time; they diverge on a part-time-only class, a reimbursing account, an Extended Benefits position, a late answer, or a reported reason that earns no relief.


[7] Overrides and inheritance. Declared overwrite: charge_evt_relief_grounds "A granted relief credits back every charge already posted within its scope" and charge_evt_credits "A relief credits the whole remaining charge of every posting within the relief's scope", replaced by the response-relief formula sentence; charge_evt_notice_and_response "otherwise payments issued before the late response stay charged even if relief is later granted", replaced by the relief answer share sentence (only a late answer without good cause is touched). Inherited: once-per-reason credits and the remaining-charge cap (345.60 <= 345.60; the netting of every standing credit keeps the credit within the charge still standing), class relief grounds (read through P relief_* tier parameters), the response window and its counting rule. The disputed charge amount is an extended quantity (overwrite []).


[8] initial_state rows and why. customers: the store (caller: 6085555371, FEIN 5371, ZIP 53790) and the claimant (named via find_claim_ledger). employer_accounts: the new-employer contributory account (reserve 8,379.72 = the six reserve credits; balance 0.00). employer_tax_ledger (24): six contribution assessments, payments and reserve credits; the six reserve credits are the financing-basis evidence; two late report penalties with their late-payment interest and payments are ordinary account history that no computation reads. employer_wage_reports (6): the reported wages behind the contributions (two filed late, behind the penalties). claims, claim_ledger (5) and claim_requests (1, the approved backdate): explain why charges posted on the notice day and the cancelled payment. charge_positions (1), charge_ledger (3): reconciled by both computations. Closure 44 = initial 44. Automatic clauses: no statement is due yet for 2026-Q4, no reissue exists, the response window is open, so nothing extra is lit.

[9] Persona. Rafferty Collingwood-Iyer, terse owner; volunteers only: Dashiell quit (moving out of state), not laid off, the store has been charged and should not be. Only when asked: last day 2026-10-16 resigned in person, not discharged, not kept on part time (rules out other reasons); payroll shows 17,280.00 base-period wages matching the notice; knows nothing of the claimant's payments. Passive: agrees to put the store's side on record and lodges the agent's details himself, accepts the amount, reads back the reference; closes when told the store was relieved with a credit, or asks once why if not.

[10] Standard solution. Locate and verify; read position, ledger, submissions (none), claim, payments, backdate request, tax account, tax ledger, wage reports; compute 345.60 and hand submit_separation_response_153a3a70 to the caller (voluntary_quit, timely); compute the relief credit on the post-response world (345.60) and call determine_charge_relief_e2b9af19 on the 2026-11-09 charge with relief_basis voluntary_quit_without_good_cause. Terminal: one response submission, position relieved, total charged 0.00, one relief credit.

[11] Easily wrong. Forgetting the cancelled-payment credit (691.20); reading the store as reimbursing or ignoring the tax account (financing basis 0.00); counting the mailing day as day one and treating the last-day answer as late (0.90 -> 311.04); computing the relief before the response exists (0.00); booking the credit on the cancelled charge; picking lack_of_work (ground share 0.00) or passing response_timeliness late.


[12] Verification outputs (final run): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (1.json 15 acts, det True, nonvac True, closure 44 = init 44); SOLVABILITY OK (verify True, calls 2, base gates 2, seed rows 4); COMPUTE OK (1.json comps 2, factors 9, cross 1, history rows 7, branches 27; sensitivities 0.00 / 0.00 / 691.20 / 0.00 / 259.20 and 0.00 / 691.20 / 0.00 / 259.20 recomputed equal); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK.

[13] Solvability vs GT and draft recomputation. Step 12's response_window evidence is the position's charge_position_id and notice_mailed_date plus frozen_time; step 14 rests on prior_step:12 and the class. From the visible context alone (rendered rules, docstrings, lookups, persona lines) the same reason, timeliness, amount, charge and basis follow.

[14] Revision log. (r1) Prose collision: "account standing share" / "response promptness share" were used by both task-1 policies, and "relief reach" by both relief policies; renamed to dispute/relief standing share, answer/relief promptness share and "response relief reach". Re-run EXTENDED OK, COMPUTE OK. (r2) Realism: the late-paid 2025-Q2 and 2026-Q1 contributions had no late-payment interest; added interest entries (15.77, 16.54) paid with the penalties; balance stays 0.00. Re-run REPLAY OK (closure 44), COMPUTE OK. (r3) Schema note: charge_requests has no amount column, so the disputed charge amount is carried by the response submission's reference (minted from every argument) and echoed in the receipt. (r4, policy-audit rework round 2) F5/T1-1: dispute_standing_share and relief_standing_share (late report penalties) removed; the task's cross-difficulty factor is now response_financing_basis (contributory class with a reserve credited with contributions -> the counted charges reach that reserve). F6/T1-2: the 'more than five days within the window' tier removed; the answer shares now follow the base timeliness rule only (on time or good cause / late without good cause / no response or lapsed). New parameter factors response_class_share and relief_ground_share (class relief grounds), relief_reach folded into relief_ground_share; draw [5,4] now disputed 5 / relief 4. Gold 295.49 -> 345.60 in both writes; total charged ends at 0.00. F2: late-response bar declared overwritten by the relief answer share. Persona: the late-report line dropped (no computation reads it). (r5, policy-audit rework round 3) R2-F1: response_class_share's fall-through is now reachable — the Extended Benefits state-share class, whose relief follows the regular claim — and tier 1 requires a regular or combined-wage claim. R2-F2 / R2-F3: both answer shares now take the on-time tier for this world and fall through to a reachable late case (after the due date without good cause, once a charge was posted past the due date, 0.75); the relief baseline no longer assumes no response; the 'no longer awaiting' and 'no response on record' tiers are gone. R2-T1-2: the notice is now mailed 2026-11-03 and the response lands on 2026-11-13, the inclusive tenth day — the near-miss in both computations (counting the mailing day as day one makes it late). Gold stays 345.60 in both writes. Observation: employer_tax_ledger count corrected to 24. A late-response world was tried and dropped: the base response_window gate must hold at the response write. (r6, policy-audit rework round 4) R3-T1-1: the edge-weight proof (prerequisite_closure skipped_effect, [2]) no longer names a zero tier of the relief answer share; on the skip world that share is 1.00 and the ground share 0.00 gives 0.00. R3-O1: both response baselines now state their default values one by one instead of narrating a single standard case that could not exist; no value moved. (r7, KB-audit rework round 5) P1/P4: the response-determination rule now says the class term on payments before a late response is applied only through the relief answer share, and that an appeal-granted relief still credits the whole remaining charge; both are declared in the overwrites. No value moved (345.60 / 345.60).
user_scenario:
You are Rafferty Collingwood-Iyer, owner of Wexcombe Hardware & Lumber Inc. in Ellery Junction, calling the Lakeland Department of Workforce Security on a Friday afternoon between customers. You are direct and a little gruff, and you keep your answers short. A notice of claim about your former assistant yard manager, Dashiell Okafor-Brandt, came in the mail last week, and when you logged into the employer portal you saw the Department has already charged the store for his benefits. Dashiell resigned on Friday, October 16, 2026, telling you he was moving out of state to help on his sister's farm; nobody laid him off, so you do not think the store should carry his benefits. You open by saying who you are, that Dashiell quit and was not laid off, that the store has already been charged for his benefits, and that you want the store not to be charged for them.

When the agent asks how to find the business, you give the store's phone number, 6085555371. To verify, you give the last four digits of the store's FEIN, 5371, and the mailing ZIP code, 53790, one at a time as the agent asks. You do not know any reference numbers.

You only mention the following if the agent asks. Dashiell's last day of work was Friday, October 16, 2026, and he resigned in person; no one offered him part-time hours to stay on, and you did not discharge him. The store's payroll shows it paid Dashiell 17,280.00 in wages for the period the notice lists, which matches the notice. You know nothing about his benefit payments or his bank account.

You want the agent to settle the charges for the store. If the agent explains that the store itself has to put its side on record before the charges can be decided, you agree to do it now; when the agent hands you the submission, you lodge it yourself in the store's name with exactly the details the agent reads out to you, and you accept the amount the agent gives you without arguing. If the agent asks, you read back the reference number it returns.

Once the agent tells you the store has been relieved and a credit has been put on its account, you thank the agent and hang up. If the agent says the store cannot be relieved, you ask once why, listen, and end the call. You do not ask for anything else.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A response is timely only when it is received no later than the response window after the notice of claim mailing date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the notice of claim mailing date, a response received on the last day is timely, and the window is never extended.

boundary_check.just_before: Counting starts the day after the 2026-11-03 mailing, so 2026-11-13 is the tenth and last day; the response received 2026-11-13 is on that last day and, the boundary being inclusive, timely.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A response received on 2026-11-14 would be the first late one; a reader who counts the mailing day itself as day one would wrongly put the last day at 2026-11-12 and treat today's response as late.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.charge_position_id: 4d7a9e05-ef00-45d4-9722-cb608587b2fe. Basis: the charge position lookup for the store returns one position, on the claim named in the notice; the docstring asks for 'the employer's chargeable position on the claim named in the notice of claim, as returned by the charge position lookup'. Uniqueness: the store holds no other position.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: 3388f921-0df8-4c41-88e1-898d67b56fc0. Basis: the profile found by the phone number 6085555371 owns the position. Uniqueness: single profile.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.separation_reason_reported: voluntary_quit. Basis: docstring 'voluntary_quit means the claimant left this employer of the claimant's own accord'; the caller says Dashiell resigned in person on October 16, 2026 to move out of state. Uniqueness: lack_of_work is denied by the caller ('nobody laid him off'); discharge_misconduct and discharge_other are excluded ('you did not discharge him'); still_employed_part_time and refused_offer_of_work are excluded ('no one offered him part-time hours to stay on'); not_reported is not used for a real response.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.response_timeliness: timely. Basis: docstring 'timely means the response is received no later than the response due date'; the position's response due date is 2026-11-13 and the response is received 2026-11-13, the last day of the window (a response received on the last day is timely). Uniqueness: late_good_cause and late require receipt after the due date; pending and none are 'not used here'.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.disputed_charge_amount: 345.60. edges.condition: The charge position is in responded status with a response_date, a separation_reason_reported other than not_reported, and a separation_response submission on record for it.
edges.policy_source: The relief credit of a determination on a separation response is not fixed until the position carries the employer's separation response, with the separation reason it reports and the date it was received recorded on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen_time the position carries no separation response: status noticed, response date empty, separation reason not_reported, timeliness pending, and no separation_response submission exists for it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's response write (step 12) sets status responded, response date 2026-11-13, separation reason voluntary_quit and timeliness timely and records a separation_response submission; the relief ground share then reads the voluntary quit the class allows and the relief answer share reads an on-time response, so the relief credit moves from 0.00 to 345.60.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the determination's relief ground share reads the separation reason and its answer share reads the response date that only the response records; reversing the writes gives a relief credit of 0.00 on a position with no response.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the response leaves separation_reason_reported not_reported and no response on record, so the relief ground share takes its zero tier (no response reports a ground) while the relief answer share stays at the whole (no late answer is on record), and relief_credit_amount recomputes to RND(MX(0, 691.20 x 0.00 - 345.60) x 1.00) = 0.00 instead of 345.60 (check_compute value_input run); the terminal state also lacks the separation_response submission and the position never passes through responded.
